title: Oakdale Town Square
caption: The bustling heart of Oakdale Town featuring cobblestone avenues, antique lampposts, flower gardens, and Cedric with his companion Meowth.

title: Prof. Oak's Research Lab
caption: Inside the lab: scientific whiteboard with elemental formulas, research mainframe terminal, starter tray, and assistant Eevee reviewing field notes.

title: Oakdale Pokémon Center
caption: The town's medical clinic where Nurse Joy and Clefairy completely heal your party. Includes network PC terminal and refreshments.

title: Whispering Woods Wilderness
caption: Venture east into Whispering Woods: navigate winding dirt paths, discover wild Bulbasaur and Pikachu in tall grass, and find hidden items.

title: Confronting the Guardian Mewtwo
caption: Deep in the northern clearing of Whispering Woods stands the legendary Mewtwo, radiating overwhelming psionic power.

title: Turn-Based Wild Battle
caption: Engage wild creatures in strategic turn-based combat. Choose between FIGHT, BAG, CATCH, and RUN with dynamic sprite animation.

title: Move Selection & Elemental Tactics
caption: Select from elemental moves (Scratch, Ember, Vine Whip, Water Gun). Each move features accurate power, type classification, and hit rates.

title: Climactic Boss Battle
caption: Face the high-level Forest Guardian Mewtwo in an intense encounter featuring custom psionic visual FX, particle explosions, and high stakes.
